content: Impatient hypoglycemia is a condition that can occur in hospitalized patients due to various factors. One of the primary causes is errors in insulin administration, such as incorrect dosing or improper timing of insulin delivery. Additionally, hypoglycemia may result from missed or delayed doses of insulin, which can disrupt blood glucose regulation. To mitigate these risks, it is essential for hospitals to implement prevention protocols. These protocols should include a thorough review of all hypoglycemia cases to identify and address any underlying systemic issues that may contribute to the occurrence of hypoglycemia.
